name: Epic Turncoat Maneuver
subtitle: curse your sudden but inevitable betrayal!
rules: COST – Destroy 2 characters you control. Pick 4 or fewer characters. -- EFFECT – Take control of the picked characters.
flavor: He'd be such a good Lieutenant if he'd just stop stabbing us!

name: Luteoderm Goliath
subtitle: i always hated that clock tower
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains 11 strength and 11 life. -- HANDOFF -- COST – Pay 6. Deplete a character you control that is not in a battle. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character.
flavor: Immediately destroyed if your opponent plays Luteoderm David.
notes: Badges read +11 STR, +0 SPD, +11 LIFE. The italic line 'Immediately destroyed if your opponent plays Luteoderm David.' is printed as flavor but is rules-like.

name: Unrelenting Ridicule
subtitle: just ignore them
rules: COST – Pick a character with COVERT. -- EFFECT – Destroy the character.
flavor: They'll get tired of it in a few hundred years or so...

name: Patent Enforcement
subtitle: stop! imposter! i already invented that!
rules: COST – Play this only in response to an item being played. Pay X, where X is its numeric cost. -- EFFECT – The item enters play under your control.
notes: Card prints 'Play this only in response to an item being played'; catalog says 'Deploy this ... being deployed'.

name: Micromajig Maker
subtitle: the little ones nag the loudest
rules: When this card enters play, you may put a Micromajig token into play. -- (Treat Micromajig tokens as Gearsmith character cards with 1 strength, 1 life, 3 speed, and the "majig" subtype. If a Micromajig token leaves play, it disappears.)
notes: Reminder text prints 'If a Micromajig token leaves play'; catalog says 'When ...'.
